fix: Add a lexicon row mapping 'early withering' / 'early-withering' to FLOPO:0991231 fugacious, whose synonyms include evanescent. Ground 'radical leaves' to basal leaf (FLOPO:0996000) by pattern 18.

fix: Add 'in each furrow' (the space between two ribs, the vallecula) as a position cue of kind per_furrow or at_region. Take the container (the fruit) from the organ of the sentence, 'Fruit ellipsoid'. The landmark stays empty because PO has no furrow class.

fix: Read FNA's '<part> 0' as absence of the part: peduncle absent, so the heads are sessile. Do not read it as a length of 0 with a missing unit.

fix: Add a lexicon row mapping 'dissimilar', said of a set of parts of one kind, to FLOPO:0991092 dimorphic (members of the set in two distinct forms). Map 'similar' to FLOPO:0991212 monomorphic.

target: superficial (sensu botany): lying level with the surrounding surface, neither raised nor sunken; said of hydathodes, veins and glands
fix: Then annotate as a continuum from superficial to prominent (PATO:0001482) with 'slightly' as the approximation cue. PATO:0001665 superficial is the relational 'superficial to' and must not be used.

fix: Slots: the sub-part (lamina, blade), the named whole it belongs to (staminode), and the measurement (length about 2 mm, width about 2.5 mm, approximate per pattern 01). OWL: has part some (lamina and part of some staminode and has characteristic some length ...). The record gives the whole in fb:container.

fix: When the transcribed quality is an attribute with no number, ground the value word itself. Here that is rotate FLOPO:0991125 on the corolla, and the measurement path should not be used.

fix: Allow a negated operand in one_of: 'not X or slightly X'. X is torsioned (PATO:0002445) and 'slightly' is a degree cue. As OWL the union is close to a tautology, so keep only the record (at most slightly twisted) without a phenotype class.
reason: This is a real character ('fruit untwisted to slightly twisted'), but one of its operands is a negation, and pattern 07 does not take that.

fix: Read '(with N teeth)' after 'margins serrate' as a count of teeth with container leaf lamina margin and range 7-15. There is no position cue. The bearer is the proximal cauline leaf (pattern 18).
reason: The number is for the whole margin of the leaf, not for a place on it, so this is not a count at a position.

fix: Map 'N mm thick' to PATO:0000915 thickness, or to PATO:0001334 diameter for a round twig, with 'up to' as the upper-bound cue. Read 'flowering' as the state of the bearer (pattern 04).
reason: 'Thick' with a number and a unit is a thickness measurement, and PATO has the attribute.

target: twining: a climbing quality (child of FLOPO:0991108 climbing) of a stem or plant that climbs by its stem coiling around a support
fix: Add it as a sibling of FLOPO:0991319 root-climbing, with synonym 'voluble'. It applies to stem and whole plant.

target: calyx lobes valvate in bud, forming apiculate or acuminate point
fix: Transcribe again as the whole alternative: a union (pattern 07) of apiculate and acuminate (PATO:0002228) on the apex formed by the calyx lobes, with 'in bud' as the stage (pattern 04).
reason: The statement was cut to 'or acuminate point', which drops the first alternative and the stage.

fix: Add the cue 'prolongé au-dessus de' (extended beyond) towards the ovary, as protruding (PATO:0001598) towards ovary. Read 'non ou à peine' as negated or at most slightly, and ground 'tube du calice' to the hypanthium or floral tube.
reason: The second term (the ovary) is in the text. The French extension cue is missing from the comparison reader.

fix: Read as one_of: papillose-pubescent, or with frequency 'rarely' glabrous approximately (the 'nearly' cue of pattern 01). 'Nearly' is an approximation, not a negation.
reason: This is the construction 'X, rarely nearly Y'. The annotator read 'nearly' as a negation cue.

target: hypogeal (germination): a quality of the cotyledons (or seed) by virtue of their remaining below the soil surface during germination; sibling epigeal
fix: Add the term under a PATO disposition or position quality, with the cotyledon (or seed) as bearer. 'Germination' should not be the entity.
reason: Hypogeal germination is a stable morphological trait of the taxon, stated as a property of the seed. It is not a process to annotate.

fix: Ground the value word green (PATO:0000320) on fruit, with berry mapped to fruit. The 'color' attribute should not go to the measurement path.

fix: Read 'slightly shorter or as long as X' as one_of: decreased length towards X (pattern 09) or equal length, ratio 1 (pattern 10). Ground 'lower lemma' to lemma with position lower (FLOPO:0991377, pattern 18).

fix: Apply count_word 'many' to pistil, as for 'stamens many', which is listed in the pattern.

target: zoochorous (animal-dispersed): a disposition of a fruit or diaspore to be dispersed by animals
fix: Add it as a dispersal disposition with fruit/diaspore as bearer, if FLOPO takes dispersal syndromes into scope. Otherwise reject.

fix: Treat the hyphenated compound as a continuum from spatulate (PATO:0001937) to oblanceolate (PATO:0002330), like 'linear-lanceolate'. Do not send it to the measurement path.

fix: Split '1-awned' using the row awned -> awn in config/flora_counted_parts.tsv: a count of 1 awn. The bearer is lower glume (glume plus position lower, pattern 18).

fix: A reviewed table maps a habit noun to the whole plant plus its qualities: liana -> whole plant with climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and a woody stem; vine -> whole plant with climbing. OWL: has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing ...). Modifiers ('élevée', '20-40 m') become separate statements.
reason: 'Liane' is a habit noun (a PO synonym of whole plant), not a value. Habit nouns are listed as an open pattern.

fix: Read '3-6(-10)-nate' (in groups of N) as a count of pedicels with position kind per_node and region 'at the lower nodes'. The extreme 10 is recorded by pattern 05. Add the '-nate' suffix to the count reader.

fix: Extend the extreme reading to indefinite counts and qualitative values. In 'few (to numerous)', 'few' is the usual value (pattern 13, used in OWL) and 'numerous' is a max extreme kept in the record only.
reason: This is the same semantics as '3-8(-11)': the usual value in the class, the rare extreme in RDF.

fix: vine -> whole plant with climbing (FLOPO:0991108), from the habit-noun table. 'Deciduous' becomes a separate statement: whole plant with deciduous (plant) PATO:0001731.
reason: Same construction as P01781: a habit noun holding a quality.

fix: Ground 'cyathial gland' by a bearer rule to nectary, part of the cyathium, as the container. Read 'on outer margin' as kind at_region with a count of teeth 3-6.

target: homostylous: a morphology quality of a flower or taxon whose flowers all have styles and stamens at the same relative level (one floral form)
fix: Add it as a sibling of FLOPO:0991137 heterostylous under PATO:0000051. Spanish 'homostilas' gets a lexicon row.

fix: Add Spanish rows to config/flora_context_words.tsv: 'maduros' -> mature PATO_0001701 (bearer_quality); 'en la base' -> base region (slot 1); 'frecuentemente' -> frequency often. The value is orange-red at the fruit base.

fix: Slots: the bearer, the comparative quality (paler, i.e. lighter colour) and an implied target resolved from the clause, here the lamina whose colour was just stated. OWL: has characteristic some (light/decreased saturation and towards some leaf lamina). The record flags the target as implicit (fb:impliedTarget).

fix: Read 'margins with 1 or 2 teeth' as a count of teeth with container leaf lamina margin and range 1-2 ('1 or 2' is the range 1-2). Use the same reading as P01768.

fix: Read as a continuum from elliptic/ellipsoid (PATO:0000947) to ovate/ovoid, 'broadly' as a modifier, on fruit. Do not use the 'oval' synonym of PATO_0001891 ovate here, and do not send it to the measurement path.

fix: A width or thickness of a moss structure measured in cell rows ('border 1 cell wide', 'costa 2 cells thick').
